data.command: What is the current TCP congestion control algorithm and queue discipline?

data.text:
```
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control net.core.default_qdisc
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = nova
net.core.default_qdisc = fq
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control
net.ipv4.tcp_available_congestion_control = reno cubic nova
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control
nova
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ tc qdisc show dev ens192
qdisc fq 0: root : limit 10000p flow_limit 100p buckets 1024 orphan_mask 0 quantum 3028b initial_quantum 15140b low_rate_threshold 550Kbit refill_delay 40.0ms
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ tc qdisc show dev ens224
qdisc fq 0: root : limit 10000p flow_limit 100p buckets 1024 orphan_mask 0 quantum 3028b initial_quantum 15140b low_rate_threshold 550Kbit refill_delay 40.0ms
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ lsmod | grep tcp
tcp_nova               24576  1
tcp_diag               16384  0
inet_diag              20480  1 tcp_diag
webapp@edge-node-04:~$ modinfo tcp_nova | head -6
filename:       /lib/modules/5.15.0-1091-edge/kernel/net/ipv4/tcp_nova.ko
description:    TCP Nova congestion control (corp-tuned build 2.4.1)
author:         NetOps Kernel Team <kernel@corp.example>
license:        GPL
depends:
retpoline:      Y
```
